title: Haggai 1: chapter overview
paragraphs: Haggai reproves the Jews for neglecting the temple.
He promises God's assistance to them.

outline.text: Haggai reproves the Jews for neglecting the temple.
He promises God's assistance to them.

context: After the return from captivity, Haggai was sent to encourage the people to rebuild the temple, and to reprove their neglect.
attribution: Matthew Henry, Concise Commentary (public domain). Historical Protestant interpretation; other traditions may read these passages differently.
